text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way home from an outing with Buena Vista—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainer-san.
Are you... hungry at all?"
choice_data_list: Actually, I'm free

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Right? We've relaxed plenty,
so next up, let's grab some food!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I know lots of delicious restaurants,
so I can show you around.
What are you in the mood to eat?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Italian, Chinese, French, Thai...
and delicious Japanese food, of course.
I'll take you anywhere you want, so leave it to me, okay?"
choice_data_list: Restaurant hopping is your hobby, huh.
Restaurant hopping is your hobby, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and I still am!
Now, where do you want to go?
Or should we search for a new place together?
choice_data_list: In that case—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since we're going out, it might as well be a place Buena Vista has never been to.
When I suggested this—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Then... there's a shop I've been curious about,
but I didn't have the courage to go alone!
How about that place?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Waaah, this really feels like a secret hideaway!
Thanks for navigating, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The food's good, but it seems like
a pretty peculiar shop.
Apparently, their system is a secret only known to customers who enter—
choice_data_list: This is kind of exciting!
This is kind of exciting, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Right! I'm really looking forward to it...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, looks like a normal Chinese restaurant to me.
What's supposed to be different about it?
choice_data_list: Let's take a look at the menu first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Written on it were ramen, fried rice,
gyoza... and even some Japanese dishes.
—Except, prefixed before every single one of them was:

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"‘Handmade by you’...?
What does this item on the menu
mean?"

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Yes, our shop's system is set up
so that customers cook everything on the menu themselves!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
We will certainly provide the necessary ingredients.
However, the recipe and seasoning
are for the customers themselves to think up and make.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Please enjoy
a menu crafted just for you!
choice_data_list: I see, this really is unusual.
I see, this really is unusual.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Sounds fun!
It reminds me of when the two of us used to play house when we were little.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Not mud balls or mud soup,
but proper real cooking together next time...
Ehehe, I'm already getting so excited♪
choice_data_list: Let's do our best and make something delicious!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Haha, love the enthusiasm!
What can I get started for you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Trainer-san, what should we have?
Should we choose from what we can make?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Or... would you rather go with this special menu?
Either one is totally fine with me as long as we can enjoy it together!"
choice_data_list: Let's stick to something we can actually make.
I want to try the special menu!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Then how about gyoza and fried rice?
choice_data_list: Nice, let's go with that then!
Sounds good, let's go with that!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wrapping gyoza with Trainer, huh?
...Fufu. You used to be pretty bad at wrapping them, right?
choice_data_list: It's different now, you know? I won't even burn the fried rice!
It's different now, okay? I won't burn the fried rice anymore!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I've practiced a lot and gotten really good too.
Why don't we... have a match?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! It's wrapped so neatly.
Amazing, amazing, you've gotten really good at this~!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Can't afford to lose either.
Heave-ho—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ta-da~♪ Bunny dumplings!
choice_data_list: Kuh, so that's how it's gonna be~!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The fried rice ingredients are... alright, this should do it!
Now all that's left is to cook...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? Trainer, your toppings are...
natto, curry, tuna, and—
choice_data_list: Since I've got the chance, I figured I'd go on an adventure!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Mumu... True, when we can use so many different ingredients, sticking to the standard ones would be a waste!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: All right, I won't lose either!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Finished!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Both kinds of gyoza look delicious, and I wonder how the fried rice turned out~?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I know!
Trainer, would you like to split it?
I was actually curious about how that flavor tasted too.
choice_data_list: Are you sure? Well then, don't mind if I do.
Are you sure? Well then, don't mind if I do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end—the cooking contest ended without a clear winner, but we spent an unforgettable time together.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I figured that'd catch your eye.
Well then, wanna give it a shot?♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Whoa, it says "Unnamed Dish." Looks like they just give you the ingredients and you have to figure out what to make yourself.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...This looks super exciting!
Shall we give it a try?
choice_data_list: Sounds good, I'm in!
Sounds good, count me in!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Sashimi, cucumbers, rolled omelet... True to the name 'Seafood Course,' these really are the perfect ingredients for a seafood bowl.
choice_data_list: Just making it normally would be boring, right?
Just making it normally would be boring, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Right on!
Since we're doing this, let's make it turn out like "Wait, this came from *those* ingredients?!"
choice_data_list: ...So, how about a seafood parfait?
...So, how about a seafood parfait? What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
A parfait?
You mean decorating these ingredients
to make it look like a parfait?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...It's great!
I think it's super good! It's gonna turn out so cute♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Then, we'll roll the salmon like roses,
finely chop the rolled omelet,
and scatter it like cornflakes—
choice_data_list: Sushi rice could pass for cream, I suppose.
Sushi rice could pass for cream, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's right♪
We'll layer it in the cup with the toppings to make the parfait's base, and then—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —All done!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, well...!
You've made quite a delightful-looking dish."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
It's a masterpiece from the two of us♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Buena Vista smile with supreme confidence
made me feel proud as well.
